2024-local-source-recorded.label: Final VP of a played match

2024-wahapedia-rule-control.label: Control
2024-wahapedia-rule-control.summary: Marker control compares the total APL of contesting operatives. Check the full rule and team exceptions.

2024-wahapedia-rule-firefight.label: Firefight phase
2024-wahapedia-rule-firefight.summary: Alternate activating ready operatives, then counteract as the rules allow.

2024-wahapedia-rule-strategy.label: Strategy phase
2024-wahapedia-rule-strategy.summary: Initiative, Ready, then alternate strategic gambits.

2024-wahapedia-mission-data.label: Data
2024-wahapedia-mission-data.summary: From turning point 2, Compile Data (1 AP): add a data unit to a controlled marker, at most once per marker per turning point. Send Data (1 AP) only in turning point 4: remove all data from a controlled marker and score that many VP. Neither action can be taken within enemy control range. At the end of turning points 2 and 3, +1 VP if you performed more Compile Data actions than the enemy.

2024-wahapedia-mission-download.label: Download
2024-wahapedia-mission-download.summary: A 1 AP action available from turning point 3 on the centre marker or an enemy-side controlled marker; not within enemy control range and not again on a marker already downloaded. At the end of turning points 2–4, +1 VP for controlling more non-downloaded markers. A download scores 1 VP in turning point 3 or 2 VP in turning point 4.

2024-wahapedia-mission-energy-cells.label: Energy Cells
2024-wahapedia-mission-energy-cells.summary: Objective markers can be picked up from turning point 2: extra cost +2 AP in turning point 2, +1 AP in 3, normal in 4; the action cannot be made free or cheaper. A carrier cannot be removed and set up more than 6" away. At the end of turning points 2–4, +1 VP for controlling more markers. At the end of the battle, +1 VP for each marker carried.

2024-wahapedia-mission-loot.label: Loot
2024-wahapedia-mission-loot.summary: After the first turning point: Loot (1 AP) on a controlled marker; not within enemy control range and not again on the same marker this turning point. +1 VP per action, at most 2 VP per turning point.

2024-wahapedia-mission-orb.label: Orb
2024-wahapedia-mission-orb.summary: The orb starts on the centre marker. After the first turning point, a 1 AP action on a controlled marker holding the orb moves it from the centre to any outer marker or back; not within enemy control range. At the end of each turning point, +1 VP for each controlled marker without the orb.

2024-wahapedia-mission-reboot.label: Reboot
2024-wahapedia-mission-reboot.summary: Number the markers 1–3. At the start of each Gambit, secretly and simultaneously pick a marker: if both pick the same one, it is inert; otherwise the unpicked one is inert. From turning point 2, Reboot (2 AP) on a controlled inert marker removes inertness; not within enemy control range. At the end of turning points 2–4, +1 VP for each controlled non-inert marker.

2024-wahapedia-mission-secure.label: Secure
2024-wahapedia-mission-secure.summary: After the first turning point: 1 AP to secure a controlled marker until the opponent secures it; not within enemy control range. At the end of each turning point, +1 VP for at least one secured marker and +1 VP if you have more than the opponent.

2024-wahapedia-mission-stake-claim.label: Stake Claim
2024-wahapedia-mission-stake-claim.summary: At the start of the Gambit in turning points 2–4, starting with the initiative: choose a marker and pledge either to control it or to keep the enemy from contesting it by the end of the turning point. Each marker can be chosen once per battle. At the end of the turning point, +1 VP for controlling more markers and +1 VP for a fulfilled pledge.

2024-wahapedia-mission-transmission.label: Transmission
2024-wahapedia-mission-transmission.summary: After the first turning point: a 1 AP action makes a controlled marker transmit until the start of the next turning point; not within enemy control range. At the end of each turning point, +1 VP for controlling at least one transmitting marker and another +1 VP for more such markers than the enemy.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-dominate.label: Dominate
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-dominate.summary: When your operative incapacitates an enemy, it gains a Dominate token, or two if the enemy has 12+ Wounds. At the end of turning points 3 and 4 you may remove tokens from your operatives that are on the killzone and not incapacitated: 1 VP per token, at most 3 VP per turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-dominate.reveal: The first time your operative incapacitates an enemy.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-envoy.label: Envoy
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-envoy.summary: As a strategic gambit in turning points 2–4, select one of your operatives as the envoy until the next Ready. You cannot repeat a previous choice or one ignored for Kill Op. At the end of the turning point, 1 VP if the envoy is wholly in enemy territory and outside enemy control range; 2 VP if it also lost no wounds this turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-envoy.reveal: The first time you select an envoy.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-flank.label: Flank
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-flank.summary: Split the killzone into two flanks with a line between the centres of the players' edges. Operatives wholly within a flank and in enemy territory contest it; control goes to the higher total APL. Once revealed, at the end of turning points 2–4, 1 VP per controlled flank; in turning point 4, 2 VP if it was also controlled in turning point 3. Overall cap 2 VP per turning point.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-martyrs.label: Martyrs
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-martyrs.summary: The first time each of your operatives is incapacitated while contesting a marker, place a Martyr token on that marker; being incapacitated again after returning gives no token. At the end of turning points 2–4 you may remove tokens from markers contested by your operatives: 1 VP each, or 2 VP each if you control the marker. At most 2 VP per turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-martyrs.reveal: The first time your operative is incapacitated while contesting a marker.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-plant-banner.label: Plant Banner
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-plant-banner.summary: From turning point 2, Plant Banner (1 AP): place the banner within the operative's control range, wholly in enemy territory and more than 5" from a neutral edge. Once per battle, not within enemy control range; the banner can be picked up. At the end of each turning point, 1 VP if it is on the killzone, wholly in enemy territory and controlled by you; 2 VP if it is also not contested by the enemy.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-plant-banner.reveal: When you take the Plant Banner action.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-plant-devices.label: Plant Devices
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-plant-devices.summary: From turning point 2, plant a device on a controlled marker for 1 AP, not within enemy control range and not where you already have a device. At the end of each turning point, 1 VP for a device on the enemy marker and 1 VP for each other marker with a device that the enemy contests; at most 2 VP.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-retrieval.label: Retrieval
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-retrieval.summary: From turning point 2, Retrieve (1 AP) on a controlled marker you have not yet searched: the operative gains a Retrieval marker; it cannot already carry a marker or be within enemy control range. Retrieval markers can be picked up. +1 VP for the first search of each marker, and +1 VP at the end of the battle for each Retrieval marker carried.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-retrieval.reveal: The first time you score VP.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-rout.label: Rout
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-rout.summary: When your operative incapacitates an enemy while within 6" of the enemy drop zone, +1 VP, or +2 VP if the enemy has 12+ Wounds. At most 2 VP per turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-rout.reveal: The first time you score VP.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-scout-enemy-moveme.label: Scout Enemy Movement
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-scout-enemy-moveme.summary: From turning point 2, Scout (1 AP): choose a ready, visible enemy more than 6" away; it is observed until the next Ready. Not on an Engage order and not within enemy control range. At the end of each turning point, 1 VP for each observed enemy visible to any of your operatives; at most 2 VP.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-steal-intelligence.label: Steal Intelligence
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-steal-intelligence.summary: Before removing an incapacitated enemy, place an intelligence marker within its control range. Your operatives can pick them up, carrying up to two, or one plus another marker. At the end of turning points 2–4, +1 VP if your operatives carry intelligence; at the end of the battle, 1 VP for each marker carried.

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-sweep-clear.label: Sweep & Clear
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-sweep-clear.summary: When an enemy operative contesting an objective marker is incapacitated, that marker is swept until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase (per the GW commentary, an Expendable operative does not make it swept). Clear action (1AP): the marker the active operative controls is cleared for the turning point; not in the first turning point or within control range of an enemy. At the end of each turning point after the first: the centre or the enemy marker is cleared and not contested by enemies — 1 VP, or 2 VP if it is also swept. If your operatives control a swept marker — 1 VP. At most 2 VP per turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-sweep-clear.reveal: The first enemy incapacitated while contesting an objective marker, or your first Clear action (whichever comes first).

2024-wahapedia-tac-op-track-enemy.label: Track Enemy
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-track-enemy.summary: A tracked enemy is a valid target for your Conceal operative within 6" that is not itself a valid target for the enemy and is outside enemy control range. At the end of turning points 2–4: one tracked enemy gives 1 VP (2 VP in turning point 4), two or more give 2 VP. At most 2 VP per turning point.
2024-wahapedia-tac-op-track-enemy.reveal: The first time you score VP.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-teams.label: Choose teams
2024-wahapedia-sequence-teams.description: Each player picks a kill team.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-terrain.label: Prepare the killzone
2024-wahapedia-sequence-terrain.description: Choose a killzone, set up terrain and agree on its types.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-crit.label: Choose Crit Op
2024-wahapedia-sequence-crit.description: Determine the shared critical operation and place the markers. Except on Bheta-Decima, markers go on the killzone floor.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-roll.label: First roll-off
2024-wahapedia-sequence-roll.description: The winner of the preliminary roll-off decides the initiative.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-zones.label: Choose drop zones
2024-wahapedia-sequence-zones.description: The player with initiative picks a drop zone; the other takes the remaining one and the Re-roll initiative card.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-operatives.label: Select roster
2024-wahapedia-sequence-operatives.description: Secretly select operatives by the team rules, then reveal rosters simultaneously.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-equipment.label: Select equipment
2024-wahapedia-sequence-equipment.description: Secretly select up to four different equipment options, then reveal simultaneously.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-tac.label: Select Tac Op
2024-wahapedia-sequence-tac.description: Secretly select one tactical operation from your team's archetypes. Reveal it at the moment stated on the card.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-items.label: Set up equipment
2024-wahapedia-sequence-items.description: Alternating, starting with the initiative, set up individual items of pre-battle equipment, not whole options.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-deploy.label: Set up operatives
2024-wahapedia-sequence-deploy.description: Alternating, starting with the initiative, set up a third of your roster rounded up, wholly within your drop zone and on a Conceal order.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-initiative.label: Determine initiative
2024-wahapedia-sequence-initiative.description: Every turning point, including the first, roll off without re-rolling ties. Team rules apply before cards, starting with the player losing the roll. Then, starting with the losing player, alternate playing initiative cards or passing until two passes in a row. A Re-roll replaces earlier modifications. The winner decides the initiative. On a tie, the player who does not currently have the initiative wins; the player who lost the roll gets the ± turning point number card, except in the fourth.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-ready.label: Ready
2024-wahapedia-sequence-ready.description: Ready your operatives. Each player gains 1 CP; from turning point 2 the player without initiative gains 2 CP instead of 1. Unspent CP are kept.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-gambit.label: Gambits and primary op
2024-wahapedia-sequence-gambit.description: Alternate strategic gambits starting with the initiative until two passes in a row. Each specific gambit once per turning point. In the first turning point, secretly lock in the primary op — Crit, Tac or Kill — as a strategic gambit.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-activate.label: Activate operatives
2024-wahapedia-sequence-activate.description: Alternating, starting with the initiative, activate a ready operative: choose an order and perform actions within its AP. After activation the operative is expended.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-counteract.label: Counteract
2024-wahapedia-sequence-counteract.description: Once all your operatives are expended, you may counteract with an expended operative on Engage: one 1 AP action, not Guard, at most 2" of movement. Each operative once per turning point. The phase ends when all operatives are expended.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-vp.label: Score VP
2024-wahapedia-sequence-vp.description: Check the Crit Op and your selected Tac Op: follow their scoring timing and limits. Each category is capped at 6 VP per battle before the bonus. Kill grade depends on currently incapacitated enemies; subtract any operative that returned. Players confirm conditional actions and control themselves.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-next.label: Next turning point
2024-wahapedia-sequence-next.description: Save CP and notes, then move to the next turning point; the first one is not skipped, there are four in total.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-four.label: Play all four turning points
2024-wahapedia-sequence-four.description: Even if one side has no operatives left, the other plays out the remaining turning points.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-kill-end.label: Extra Kill VP
2024-wahapedia-sequence-kill-end.description: The player with the higher kill grade at the end of the battle gains 1 more Kill Op VP; on a tie, nobody does.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-primary-end.label: Reveal primary op
2024-wahapedia-sequence-primary-end.description: Reveal primary ops simultaneously. The bonus is half the VP earned in the chosen category, rounded up.

2024-wahapedia-sequence-result.label: Determine the result
2024-wahapedia-sequence-result.description: More total VP wins, equal VP is a draw. In KILLSTASS the second player confirms the result before it counts in stats.
